verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs state you can deploy a dedicated instance on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 GPUs with autoscaling and a private endpoint. They pitch it for running your own weights or for data isolation, which covers dedicated capacity, autoscaling and isolation from the shared pool. The evidence is only short overview-page lines, with no detailed configuration docs or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: documentation of autoscaling configuration (min/max replicas, scale-to-zero, scaling triggers), deployment workflow details, and independent or hands-on confirmation of dedicated deployments.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool
